reviews.text: These guys are great… friendly, knowledgeable!  All of my issues turned out to be more complicated than expected, but they creatively problem solved all of it!  Will definitely use this company again!

We have used The Plumber for years and have always been blown away at their promptness, professionalism, and very fair pricing.  Curt and the team do amazing work and are so responsive, especially to emergencies.  We've had them resolve several items in the past 3 months alone and they always exceed expectations.  Don't hesitate to call The Plumber!

Curt spent considerable time diagnosing the runs of the pipes in my house in order to best correct a slab leak problem To his credit with just a few holes in sheet rock, he was able to reroute my water supply away from the 22 ft long and old leaking pipe under my slab.   Problem fixed for half the price of a destructive slab leak repair and I do not have to worry about another slab leak ever.  Strongly suggest you give Curt a call.

Kurt reached out to me to correct an issue I had. That shows true integrity and how he stands behind his values.

This man is very responsible and a true master at his work

Highly recommended! The Plumber has outstanding and highly professional service when it comes to repairing plumbing issues. I have been using their service for a toilet leak, which Kurt was very detailed and thorough on what repair was needed as well as a kitchen sink repair, which James and Nate took care of in a quickly manner. Curt, Casey, and Nate are experts in their field. Timely and polite. Explained the process thoroughly. Installed new freestanding tub, faucets, and toilet for my master bathroom renovation and I am very happy with the results. They are perfectionists!

This past week I had a drain clog from my laundry room washing machine. Curt and Casey immediately addressed the issue and cleared the clog quickly! Highly recommend!

Curt came out and was quickly able to diagnose why we have been having a problem with our sink and laundry backing up. He was exceptionally polite and professional and talked me through every step of what he was doing and why. He was able to fit a pipe, build a clean out for us on the outside of the house, and snake the pipes all in under two hours. Do yourself a favor and call The Plumber if you’re looking for an honest, affordable service and a job done right. Thanks again, Curt!

We just moved here two years ago and had not needed a plumber until we recently had a toilet seal leak.
James and Nate came out today. They were GREAT!! Knowledgeable and professional and fully explained everything. I also like the up-front, flat-rate pricing.
I’m really glad to find my new go-to plumbing company.
Keep up the great work!!

Kurt is the best Plumber I have ever dealt with.  He is honest and fair.  The first time I used him was to unplugged toilet.  Because of trees, I had different people out 2-3 times a year.  Kurt came out and cleaned the pipes and I have not had to have them done again in 3 years.  I then got estimates for hot water heater -- another plumber gave a price and I thought it was high - I called Kurt and got a price that was 1/3 the amount.  Finally - I am upgrading my bathroom and he gave me a price

Five star service by James and Nate. These gentlemen came to my home due to a leak in the laundry room. I was certain that it was a slab leak but after careful troubleshooting they found the AC condensation line was improperly installed. They fixed this issue and two others promptly. I'm hesitant at times to write reviews but this company is top notch. If you need plumbing work do yourself a favor and call this company. They do the job right and will take care of you.

Called with leaky fawcetts outside, they were 33 years old.  Made appt and he showed up, charged less than quoted and fixed great.  I am tough to please and he is getting a 5 star rating.  Had to go through brick and fixed beautifully.  You should call!!!

Returned from vacation to find a leaky water heater with clogged drain valve and no drip pan (previous remodel project - i should have known better).  Called and had Kurt at the house within an hour.   He went WAY beyond my expectations.  Great work.  Fast repair.  Cleaned up.  Good advice for maintenance.  Well worth the price - which was very competitive in the first place.   Would strongly recommend The Plumber.

Curt came by this afternoon and repaired three of our toilets.  He was very professional and knew what he was doing.  He is very polite and customer oriented.  You can feel confident that he well give you a fair price for what is required to be repaired.  I highly recommend him for your plumbing needs.

We have needed Curt to help us twice now in the past 6 months and appreciate him so much! He gives a fair quote and explains what he believes the issue is ahead of time. He is amazing at what he does and is such a nice guy! He replaced old cast iron pipes in the front bathroom and helped with a clog today. Definitely recommend The Plumber.

You will not find a more honest reliable outstanding and professional plumbers out there these guys are the REAL DEAL - the absolute BEST and if you go anywhere else -you’ll be sorry - trust me on this!!!!
From Sandy in the office to  James and Nate who took care of my HUGE pipe leak -they rebuilt the whole leaking manifold and repaired the drain - they were and ARE complete  lifesavers and wasted no time in fixing my leak
If I could rate them higher  I 100% would!!!!

Absolutely AMAZING! Had a clog in our mainline that wouldn’t budge even with a 50ft auger. After hours of trying, we called The Plumber and he had us back in business in no time. Such wonderful people who are incredibly knowledgeable and the BEST at what they do! We will never call anyone else. Thank you so much!!

Nate and James came in the house.  Looked at was going on under the sink and replaced all the pipes, and installed my new garbage disposal for us. They were efficient and friendly.  Very cost effective.  I highly recommend them!!

Our kitchen floor had felt warm for several weeks, then one Saturday we came home and found water slowly coming up around the cabinets.  We called another plumbing company but they couldn't come out until that next Tuesday.  That company, however, gave us "The Plumber's" info, and Curt (the owner) himself was out at our house within a couple hours. The guys who showed up for my plunged bathroom sinks were experts. They explained their process thoroughly, provided some preventative maintenance going forward, cleaned up, and even applied some extra glue to the existing under-sink pipes. HIGHLY RECOMMEND, would definitely do business again.

After reading the reviews on Google and Nextdoor; contacted "The Plumber" and fortunately Curt was able to come by the same day.  He arrived 10 minutes ahead of the appointment time. Our kitchen sink was clogged; Curt explained why my clearing the clog out probably didn't last and immediately started working on the issue. Fast,
Friendly,
and Efficient!!!

THANK YOU FOR SAVING US TODAY!!!!! We drove 30 minutes away just to use a handicapped accessible bathroom last night so I could take my wheelchair in. Y'all got here and saved the day today, you made this handicapped gal so thankful we didn't have to make the run again today.

I have had several plumbers do work for me and none compare to these guys!! They have always quickly diagnosed the problem and resolved it at a fair price. They are kind, pleasant, and knowledgeable. Give them a call 👍🏻. You will be glad 👍🏻👍🏻 …

Fantastic experience.  Sandy was communicative and empathetic in scheduling during a very busy time, and James and Nate were prompt, accurate, neat, professional, and fixed the leak in record time.  Reasonable rates.  Highly recommend making this your go-to plumbing service -- we definitely have!

Five stars all the way for Curt and his team!  I had a near-disaster with a leaky water heater, and Curt was able to get me sorted out the same day.  It is abundantly clear that he takes tremendous pride in his work, and took extra time to walk me through some of the details that certainly sets his work apart from the competition.

Pricing was very, very fair when compared to other big-name plumbing outfits that frankly will rob you based on your zip code.  There were no mysteries about the pric

We heard running water that sounded like it was in the bathroom but we could not locate a leak.  We turned off all of the water and found the meter was still showing a leak somewhere.   I isolated the leak to the hot water line when I turned off the hot water the sound stopped. We waited a day or so to see if we could locate the leak when we felt the tiles in front of the bathroom sink were very warm which confirmed our suspicions that we likely had a slab leak.

These folks were great. Our hot water heater flooded and we needed a timely replacement as we had sold the house and needed to move out. We had to pay for the home warranty for the new buyers and attempted to go through the old Republic warranty company for service. Big mistake. After holding on the phone for 50 minutes each and being denied rightful service and every time and dealing with multiple worthless plumbing company’s like Black Tie and SWAT dispatched to our house to offer no service w

We have used Curt on several occasions. First to replace the water heaters, and a few other times to update the bathroom fixtures. He is friendly, knowledgeable, always willing to explain what is going on and provide advice, and very affordable. If you need a plumber,hands down this is who I would call.

Very polite, professional, reliable, affordable and quick. Don't call anyone else. We thought we had a leak under the foundation, he was able to identify the problem which was with our AC saving us a lot of money. And the clogged toilet was fixed very quickly. Thank you!

Curt was out quickly, found the leak, and repaired a worn out valve. I was prepared to pay thousands for a slab leak but Curt was honest and barely charged me anything for the valve repair.
I will call every time I need a plumber.

**Disclaimer** I have never actually gotten to work with The Plumber.

I decided to contact The Plumber due to being local to Grapevine and the great ratings. Unfortunately, when I tried calling to get some plumbing work done on my home, the call went to voicemail and the mail box was full so I could not even leave a message.
I've used the plumber a couple of different times now. Each time he has been fairly priced and very prompt. The plumber will continue to be my go to for our plumping needs.

Curt did a great job fixing a difficult slab leak for a reasonable price.  He even brought in another specialst to verify his findings before cutting my slab.  I appreciate his professionalism and experience and will defintely use him in the future.

I called him, and he came out the same day to install my Roman Faucet. He was very professional, knowledgable, and reliable. The job did not take as much time and effort as he expected, so he actually lowered his price from originally quoted. I will DEFINITELY be calling him again. Wonderful work!
Curt and his team are fantastic! They really took care of us. Great work and fair pricing. Thanks!

Called to schedule a service, got Kurt's wife (which is common, she seems to do the scheduling), who put us down for the following week.  Following week no call, no service, nothing.  Called to see what was up and left a voicemail, again no response.  He may do good work (though he did screw up the hot/cold lines the one time he was out and tried to sell us hard on a whole house softener) but I won't ever call them again.
Kurt is the best.  He was on time and took care of the outside leak for a fair price.  He is professional and knows his craft.  Highly recommend and will use them again.
We used the services of The Plumber for a toilet repair after another plumber had almost ruined it. This company though is very professional, fair, knowledgeable and prompt....Highly recommend them.
Curt, The Plumber is a terrific craftsman. Very experienced and knowledgable. Most imprtantly, honest and fair. Always resposive and available. Not A plumber;  The Plumber
James was very friendly and helped me out and gave me good advice for a repair I could do my self. They definitely have my business in the future for my pluming needs.

You would be hard pressed to find a plumber as honest, professional and a master of his trade. Before now I didn't think it was realistic to find this level of transparency. Kurt thanks for what you do and may God reward you abundantly. Kudos my friend.
Super easy to schedule an appointment with and responsive. Nate and James did a great job. Definitely would recommend.
Top notch! I have used The Plumber since moving to Texas, always a great experience.
This place was highly recommended to us and for a good reason. We also highly recommend the Plumber!
James stopped by and was super helpful. It was a small job, and based on this, I'll definitely use them when I have a bigger problem.
Great service as always!!
